name: CME Group
description: CME Group runs the world's largest derivatives marketplace (futures and options on interest rates, stock indexes, currencies, energy, farm goods and metals) and the clearing house that guarantees every trade. It earns a small fee per contract traded and cleared, so revenue rises with trading volume and volatility; average daily volume hit a record 28.1 million contracts in 2025. Because it guarantees trades, it also holds large amounts of customer collateral and earns interest on it. It also sells market data and runs the BrokerTec (Treasury bonds) and EBS (foreign exchange) trading platforms. The operating margin was 64.9% in 2025 because costs are mostly fixed.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not re-checked. SEC SIC code is 6200 (Security & Commodity Brokers, Dealers, Exchanges & Services).

hq.note: From general knowledge; cover page not re-read in this pass.

employees.note: About 2,230 in the US and 1,645 elsewhere (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Clearing and transaction fees
businessLines.how: A per-contract fee charged for each futures or options trade and clearing, at rates that vary by product, venue and customer type (members pay less); volume is the driver, and volatility raises volume.

businessLines.name: Market data and information services
businessLines.how: Subscription licences for real-time and historical price data sold to trading firms, banks and data vendors; recurring.

businessLines.name: Other revenue
businessLines.how: Access, connectivity and other fees; composition not extracted.
